title: Doraji Bowl with Egyptian Kissed Chickpeas
description: A flavorful and nutritious bowl filled with doraji marinated in Egyptian spices and topped with kissed chickpeas.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together Egyptian spices, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and salt.
2. Add the doraji to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
4. Remove the doraji from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
5. Grill the doraji for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
6. In a separate bowl, toss the kissed chickpeas with a pinch of salt.
7. To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of grilled doraji on the bottom, followed by a spoonful of kissed chickpeas.
8. Serve immediately, garnished with additional Egyptian spices if desired.
